question: Using HPA cell-line analysis scores, compare every PROGENy signature with every CytoSig signature across cell lines measured by both. For each signature pair use finite z-scores, require at least thirty shared cell lines, and calculate Spearman correlation without filtering on the supplied significance label. Report the number of eligible pairs and the ten largest absolute correlations, with signed rho and matched-cell-line count; break ties by PROGENy name then CytoSig name. For the strongest pair fit an ordinary least-squares line predicting CytoSig z-score from PROGENy z-score on the same matched lines. Report slope, intercept and R-squared, then the twelve cell lines with the largest absolute residual, ties alphabetically. Give their scores, prediction, residual and primary disease from the cell-line metadata, without exporting patient metadata. Draw the correlation heatmap and a score scatter of the twelve largest-residual cell lines with the fitted line, plus residual bars; supply the correlation matrix and the twelve-cell-line table and avoid treating correlated inferred signatures as proof of pathway causality. If a requested ranked list has fewer eligible members, return every eligible member and state the count.

turns.text: All metadata matches 1:1. Now let me compute Spearman correlations for all PROGENy × CytoSig pairs using average ranks (to handle ties).

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input:
{"query": "WITH pro AS (
  SELECT cell_line, name AS pname, TRY_CAST(z_score AS DOUBLE) AS z
  FROM cell_line_analysis_data WHERE analysis_type='PROGENy'
),
cyto AS (
  SELECT cell_line, name AS cname, TRY_CAST(z_score AS DOUBLE) AS z
  FROM cell_line_analysis_data WHERE analysis_type='CytoSig'
),
pr AS (
  SELECT cell_line, pname, (rn_min+rn_max)/2.0 AS r
  FROM (
    SELECT cell_line, pname,
      MIN(rn) OVER (PARTITION BY pname, z) AS rn_min,
      MAX(rn) OVER (PARTITION BY pname, z) AS rn_max
    FROM (
      SELECT cell_line, pname, z, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pname ORDER BY z) AS rn
      FROM pro
    )
  )
),
cr AS (
  SELECT cell_line, cname, (rn_min+rn_max)/2.0 AS r
  FROM (
    SELECT cell_line, cname,
      MIN(rn) OVER (PARTITION BY cname, z) AS rn_min,
      MAX(rn) OVER (PARTITION BY cname, z) AS rn_max
    FROM (
      SELECT cell_line, cname, z, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cname ORDER BY z) AS rn
      FROM cyto
    )
  )
)
SELECT pr.pname, cr.cname, COUNT(*) AS n, ROUND(corr(pr.r, cr.r)::DOUBLE, 6) AS rho
FROM pr JOIN cr USING(cell_line)
GROUP BY pr.pname, cr.cname
ORDER BY ABS(corr(pr.r, cr.r)) DESC, pr.pname, cr.cname"}

turns.text: All 602 pairs are eligible (each shares all 1,206 cell lines with finite z-scores). The strongest pair is **PROGENy TGFb vs CytoSig TGFB1** (rho = 0.874882). Let me fit the OLS line for this pair.

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input:
{"query": "WITH p AS (
  SELECT cell_line, TRY_CAST(z_score AS DOUBLE) AS pz FROM cell_line_analysis_data WHERE analysis_type='PROGENy' AND name='TGFb'
),
c AS (
  SELECT cell_line, TRY_CAST(z_score AS DOUBLE) AS cz FROM cell_line_analysis_data WHERE analysis_type='CytoSig' AND name='TGFB1'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n,
       ROUND(corr(cz,pz)::DOUBLE,8) AS pearson_r,
       ROUND(regr_slope(cz,pz)::DOUBLE,8) AS slope,
       ROUND(regr_intercept(cz,pz)::DOUBLE,8) AS intercept,
       ROUND(regr_r2(cz,pz)::DOUBLE,8) AS r2,
       ROUND(avg(pz)::DOUBLE,8) AS mean_pz,
       ROUND(avg(cz)::DOUBLE,8) AS mean_cz
FROM p JOIN c USING(cell_line)"}

turns.text: OLS fit computed. Now let me compute residuals for all matched cell lines and identify the twelve largest absolute residuals (ties alphabetical).

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input:
{"query": "WITH p AS (
  SELECT cell_line, TRY_CAST(z_score AS DOUBLE) AS pz FROM cell_line_analysis_data WHERE analysis_type='PROGENy' AND name='TGFb'
),
c AS (
  SELECT cell_line, TRY_CAST(z_score AS DOUBLE) AS cz FROM cell_line_analysis_data WHERE analysis_type='CytoSig' AND name='TGFB1'
),
fit AS (
  SELECT regr_slope(c.cz,p.pz) AS slope, regr_intercept(c.cz,p.pz) AS intercept
  FROM p JOIN c USING(cell_line)
)
SELECT p.cell_line,
       ROUND(p.pz::DOUBLE,6) AS pro_z,
       ROUND(c.cz::DOUBLE,6) AS cyto_z,
       ROUND((fit.intercept + fit.slope*p.pz)::DOUBLE,6) AS pred,
       ROUND((c.cz - (fit.intercept + fit.slope*p.pz))::DOUBLE,6) AS resid,
       ROUND(ABS(c.cz - (fit.intercept + fit.slope*p.pz))::DOUBLE,6) AS absresid
FROM p JOIN c USING(cell_line) CROSS JOIN fit
ORDER BY ABS(c.cz - (fit.intercept + fit.slope*p.pz)) DESC, p.cell_line
LIMIT 15"}

turns.text: The twelve largest-absolute-residual cell lines are clear (no boundary ties). Let me pull their metadata (primary disease, excluding patient columns) and compute precise values.

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input:
{"query": "WITH p AS (
  SELECT cell_line, TRY_CAST(z_score AS DOUBLE) AS pz FROM cell_line_analysis_data WHERE analysis_type='PROGENy' AND name='TGFb'
),
c AS (
  SELECT cell_line, TRY_CAST(z_score AS DOUBLE) AS cz FROM cell_line_analysis_data WHERE analysis_type='CytoSig' AND name='TGFB1'
),
fit AS (
  SELECT regr_slope(c.cz,p.pz) AS slope, regr_intercept(c.cz,p.pz) AS intercept
  FROM p JOIN c USING(cell_line)
),
res AS (
  SELECT p.cell_line, p.pz, c.cz, fit.intercept + fit.slope*p.pz AS pred,
         c.cz - (fit.intercept + fit.slope*p.pz) AS resid
  FROM p JOIN c USING(cell_line) CROSS JOIN fit
),
top12 AS (
  SELECT cell_line FROM res
  ORDER BY ABS(resid) DESC, cell_line
  LIMIT 12
)
SELECT r.cell_line, r.pz AS pro_z, r.cz AS cyto_z, r.pred, r.resid, m."Primary disease" AS primary_disease
FROM res r
JOIN top12 t ON r.cell_line = t.cell_line
LEFT JOIN rna_cell_lines m ON r.cell_line = m."Cell line"
ORDER BY ABS(r.resid) DESC, r.cell_line"}

WITH pro AS (

pr AS (

      MIN(rn) OVER (PARTITION BY pname, z) AS rn_min,

    FROM (
      SELECT cell_line, pname, z, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pname ORDER BY z) AS rn

    )
  )
),
cr AS (
  SELECT cell_line, cname, (rn_min+rn_max)/2.0 AS r
  FROM (
    SELECT cell_line, cname,
      MIN(rn) OVER (PARTITION BY cname, z) AS rn_min,
      MAX(rn) OVER (PARTITION BY cname, z) AS rn_max
    FROM (
      SELECT cell_line, cname, z, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cname ORDER BY z) AS rn
      FROM cyto

)
SELECT pr.pname, cr.cname, COUNT(*) AS n, ROUND(corr(pr.r, cr.r)::DOUBLE, 6) AS rho

WITH p AS (
  SELECT cell_line, TRY_CAST(z_score AS DOUBLE) AS pz FROM cell_line_analysis_data WHERE analysis_type='PROGENy' AND name='TGFb'
),
c AS (
  SELECT cell_line, TRY_CAST(z_score AS DOUBLE) AS cz FROM cell_line_analysis_data WHERE analysis_type='CytoSig' AND name='TGFB1'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n,
       ROUND(corr(cz,pz)::DOUBLE,8) AS pearson_r,
       ROUND(regr_slope(cz,pz)::DOUBLE,8) AS slope,
       ROUND(regr_intercept(cz,pz)::DOUBLE,8) AS intercept,
       ROUND(regr_r2(cz,pz)::DOUBLE,8) AS r2,
       ROUND(avg(pz)::DOUBLE,8) AS mean_pz,
       ROUND(avg(cz)::DOUBLE,8) AS mean_cz
FROM p JOIN c USING(cell_line)

WITH p AS (
  SELECT cell_line, TRY_CAST(z_score AS DOUBLE) AS pz FROM cell_line_analysis_data WHERE analysis_type='PROGENy' AND name='TGFb'
),
c AS (
  SELECT cell_line, TRY_CAST(z_score AS DOUBLE) AS cz FROM cell_line_analysis_data WHERE analysis_type='CytoSig' AND name='TGFB1'
),
fit AS (
  SELECT regr_slope(c.cz,p.pz) AS slope, regr_intercept(c.cz,p.pz) AS intercept
  FROM p JOIN c USING(cell_line)
)
SELECT p.cell_line,
       ROUND(p.pz::DOUBLE,6) AS pro_z,
       ROUND(c.cz::DOUBLE,6) AS cyto_z,
       ROUND((fit.intercept + fit.slope*p.pz)::DOUBLE,6) AS pred,
       ROUND((c.cz - (fit.intercept + fit.slope*p.pz))::DOUBLE,6) AS resid,
       ROUND(ABS(c.cz - (fit.intercept + fit.slope*p.pz))::DOUBLE,6) AS absresid
FROM p JOIN c USING(cell_line) CROSS JOIN fit
ORDER BY ABS(c.cz - (fit.intercept + fit.slope*p.pz)) DESC, p.cell_line
LIMIT 15

WITH p AS (
  SELECT cell_line, TRY_CAST(z_score AS DOUBLE) AS pz FROM cell_line_analysis_data WHERE analysis_type='PROGENy' AND name='TGFb'
),
c AS (
  SELECT cell_line, TRY_CAST(z_score AS DOUBLE) AS cz FROM cell_line_analysis_data WHERE analysis_type='CytoSig' AND name='TGFB1'
),
fit AS (
  SELECT regr_slope(c.cz,p.pz) AS slope, regr_intercept(c.cz,p.pz) AS intercept
  FROM p JOIN c USING(cell_line)
),
res AS (
  SELECT p.cell_line, p.pz, c.cz, fit.intercept + fit.slope*p.pz AS pred,
         c.cz - (fit.intercept + fit.slope*p.pz) AS resid
  FROM p JOIN c USING(cell_line) CROSS JOIN fit
),
top12 AS (
  SELECT cell_line FROM res
  ORDER BY ABS(resid) DESC, cell_line
  LIMIT 12
)
SELECT r.cell_line, r.pz AS pro_z, r.cz AS cyto_z, r.pred, r.resid, m."Primary disease" AS primary_disease
FROM res r
JOIN top12 t ON r.cell_line = t.cell_line
LEFT JOIN rna_cell_lines m ON r.cell_line = m."Cell line"
ORDER BY ABS(r.resid) DESC, r.cell_line

WITH pro AS (
  SELECT cell_line, name AS pname, TRY_CAST(z_score AS DOUBLE) AS z
  FROM cell_line_analysis_data WHERE analysis_type='PROGENy'
),
cyto AS (
  SELECT cell_line, name AS cname, TRY_CAST(z_score AS DOUBLE) AS z
  FROM cell_line_analysis_data WHERE analysis_type='CytoSig'
),
pr AS (
  SELECT cell_line, pname, (rn_min+rn_max)/2.0 AS r
  FROM (SELECT cell_line, pname, MIN(rn) OVER (PARTITION BY pname, z) rn_min, MAX(rn) OVER (PARTITION BY pname, z) rn_max
        FROM (SELECT cell_line, pname, z, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pname ORDER BY z) rn FROM pro))
),
cr AS (
  SELECT cell_line, cname, (rn_min+rn_max)/2.0 AS r
  FROM (SELECT cell_line, cname, MIN(rn) OVER (PARTITION BY cname, z) rn_min, MAX(rn) OVER (PARTITION BY cname, z) rn_max
        FROM (SELECT cell_line, cname, z, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cname ORDER BY z) rn FROM cyto))
),
rho AS (
  SELECT pr.pname, cr.cname, corr(pr.r, cr.r) AS r
  FROM pr JOIN cr USING(cell_line)
  GROUP BY pr.pname, cr.cname
)
